acceptance: Install and activation request minimal origin permissions and no remotely downloaded executable JS.

positive.fixture: reproducible package, installed permission set equals activeTab/scripting/storage, no install-time hosts, grant needs a browser permission
positive.command: pnpm --filter @vsf/extension run package && node tools/checks/src/cli.ts ext-audit

negative.fixture: audit rejects mv2, extra permissions, remote script, eval, importScripts, unlisted network sink, wasm import, oversize or foreign file types

regression.command: pnpm --filter @vsf/browser-tests exec playwright test specs/extension-install.spec.ts specs/extension-permissions.spec.ts specs/extension-package.spec.ts

versions.primitive: no primitive change; wasm ABI 4, protocol vsf-ext-v1, pairing and session endpoints v1

security_and_source_permissions: Optional per-site hosts; a page cannot fetch extension files; no externally_connectable.
known_limitations: Permission prompt needs a user gesture and is checked by hand
